page.notes: Greek and Arabic words are transcribed as far as legible; the Arabic script and some Greek forms (e.g. "ὑπέρνικος", "φάσι", "κυβὰς") are my best reading of a small, slightly blurred print and should be checked against the scan. The Arabic line "اللہ اکبر" and the "howa cobar allah" line are transliterated as printed. Left margin holds no text, only a dot and a rule.
